sources.title: Temperature, Top-K and Top-P Sampling in LLMs - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Sampling techniques control how language models choose the next word during text generation. The model assigns probabilities to possible words and sampling determines which one is picked. By adjusting these methods, you can balance creativity and accuracy in generated responses.
